page_summary: This page discusses cybersecurity collaboration networks in ports, highlighting ChainPORT and FERM. ChainPORT is a global network established in 2015 for sharing best practices in port digitalization and cybersecurity. FERM is a Netherlands-based collaborative network focused on enhancing digital security across critical infrastructure in ports through information sharing and joint risk assessments.
